h1: Custom Full Color Pens for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Pens | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color pens for your brand. Vibrant, all-over printing on bulk pens. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration transforms a standard pen into a vibrant marketing tool. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color allows you to reproduce logos, photos, or intricate artwork across the entire barrel. Pens like the Multi Color Giraffe or the EcoPal Pen become mini billboards that grab attention. This option works especially well for creative brands, event giveaways, or any campaign where visual impact matters. Choose full color to make your message pop.
heroAltText: Custom full color pens with vibrant all-over printing for brand promotion
